reason: Revised spec E-20260926-04-r2 adds a non-curator cross-encoder rerank arm and pins pool depth, packing and the served-token ceiling. It requires Holm-adjusted intervals to ship curation or keep it as a rerank feature, separates an operational default from evidence of a small gain, and corrects the source reading (152 untouched test cases, not 503). It can move B7 (lead) against a strong-retrieval control before the H3 curate step ships; it stays queued while policy is unset.
